name: experience_loader
tagline_zh: 调教技能的技能：experience_loader。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Load relevant OpenViking experience memories via case-linked experience candidates before solving a task.
unshelve_reason: 问一 · path 自己写着 `benchmark/tau2/train/experience_loader_template`——它是 OpenViking 跑 τ²-bench 航空客服评测用的训练模板，门禁判据全绑在舱位、订单状态、航段这些 benchmark 字段上，而且离了平台侧的 search_experience / read_experience 两个工具什么都不做。框架里的夹具，不是商品。 正文原话：Skip experiences whose situation explicitly excludes your case (e.g. wrong cabin class, flights already flown, different action family, or different change type).
